projects.name: MultiCloud agreement with AWS
projects.quote: But the biggest news of all was signing a MultiCloud agreement with AWS—including our latest technology Exadata hardware and Version 23ai of our database software—embedded into AWS cloud datacenters.

projects.name: Oracle's largest cloud datacenter (800 MW, NVIDIA GPU clusters)
projects.quote: The largest of these datacenters is 800 megawatts and will contain acres of NVIDIA GPU Clusters for training large scale AI models.

projects.name: Oracle Cloud regions at Microsoft
projects.quote: At the end of Q1, 7 Oracle Cloud regions were live at Microsoft with 24 more being built, and 4 Oracle Cloud regions were live at Google with 14 more being built.
